THE HINDU DISPOSITION OF PROPERTY ACT, 1916
THE HINDU DISPOSITION OF PROPERTY ACT, 1916
ACT No. XV OF 1916
[28th
September, 1916]
An Act to remove certain existing disabilities in respect of the power
of disposition of property by Hindus for the benefit of persons not in
existence at the date of such disposition.
1. Short title and extent‑(1) This Act may be called the
Hindu Disposition of Property Act, 1916.
Subs. by
the Central Laws (Statute Reform) Ordinance, 1960 (21 of 1960), s. 3 and 2nd
Sch. (with effect from the 14th October, 1955), for the original sub‑section
(2) as amended by A. O., 1937 and A. O., 1949, Sch. [(2) It extends to
the whole of Pakistan.]

Dispositions for the benefit of persons not in existence

THE HINDU DISPOSITION OF PROPERTY ACT, 1916
THE HINDU DISPOSITION OF PROPERTY ACT, 1916
ACT No. XV OF 1916
[28th
September, 1916]
An Act to remove certain existing disabilities in respect of the power
of disposition of property by Hindus for the benefit of persons not in
existence at the date of such disposition.
2. Dispositions for the benefit of persons not in existence-- Subject
to the limitations and provisions specified in he this Act, no disposition of
property by a Hindu whether by tran sfer fer inter vivos or by will shall be
invalid by reason only that any person for whose benefit it may have been made
was not in exis tence at the date of such disposition.

Limitation and condition

3. Limitation and condition--- The limitations and provisions
referred to in section 2 shall be the following, namely : ‑
(a) in respect of dispositions by
transfer inter viros, those contained in Subs. By the
Transfer of Property (Amdt.) Supplementary Act, 1929 (21 of 1929), s. 12, for
"sections 13, 14 and 20". [Chapter 11] of the Transfer of
Property Act, 1882, and IV of 1882.
(b) in respect of dispositions by
will, those contained in Subs. ibid., for "sections 100 and 101 of the Indian
Succession Act, 1865". [sections 113, 114, 115 and 116 of the the
Succession Act, 1925]. XXXIX of 1925.

Rep. by the Transfer of Property (Amdt.) Supplementary Act, 1929 (XXI of 1929), s. 12.
